# quickqr2

> Ad-subsidized QR platform (successor to quickqr.app): free dynamic redirects with editable destinations and scan analytics, plus client-side static QR via URL compression. Go backend, Svelte 5 + TypeScript 7 frontend.

Monorepo layout: `backend/` (Go 1.23+ redirect + REST API), `frontend/` (Vite, Svelte 5, plain CSS), `compression_reference/` (upstream reference compressor). Human and coding-agent canonical detail lives in `AGENTS.md`. Dev: backend `PORT=8080` from `backend/`; frontend `bun run dev` (proxies `/api` and `/r` to the backend).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Vision, stack, compression reference, API routes, directory map — primary context for AI assistants
- [frontend/README.md](frontend/README.md): Frontend scripts and typecheck
- [backend/.env.example](backend/.env.example): OAuth and server environment variables

## Backend

- [backend/cmd/server/main.go](backend/cmd/server/main.go): HTTP server entry, routing, graceful shutdown
- [backend/internal/api/handlers.go](backend/internal/api/handlers.go): Links CRUD, analytics, sponsors API
- [backend/internal/redirect/redirect.go](backend/internal/redirect/redirect.go): Public `/r/:code` gateway and interstitial
- [backend/internal/storage/storage.go](backend/internal/storage/storage.go): In-memory link store (nothing is persisted)

## Frontend

- [frontend/package.json](frontend/package.json): Dependencies and npm scripts
- [frontend/src/index.css](frontend/src/index.css): Tokens, preflight, and the `qq-*` type styles

## Optional

- [compression_reference/README.md](compression_reference/README.md): Upstream static URL shortener reference (the original compressor)
- [compression_reference/docs/compress.js](compression_reference/docs/compress.js): BigInt URL compression pipeline (port source for static mode)
